assets.name: cartoon-directions
assets.prompt:
A RADICAL STYLE EXPLORATION SHEET for TWO original human characters, in the graphic cartoon videogame visual territory of Cult of the Lamb, the original drawn Binding of Isaac art, and Castle Crashers. This must emphatically NOT look like anime, manga, Disney realism, Arcane, or a conventional pretty fantasy comic.
REFERENCES: image1 and image2 supply ONLY identifying motifs, NOT rendering style or anatomy.
Woman: teal-blue asymmetrical hair blob, small purple angular cheek mark, tiny green accents in otherwise graphic eyes, choker, grey shoulders.
Man: dark tousled hair blob, warm brown skin, simple dark moustache/chin patch, large dark scarf and leather shoulders.
Transform both into odd, appealing chunky HUMAN CARTOON PORTRAITS. Head 3x the visible shoulder height, broad uneven skull, almost no neck, simple bean/egg/squircle head shapes, minimal nose mark, huge simple eye shapes or black oval eyes with at most a tiny glint. No almond eyes. No eyelashes, eyeliner, rendered irises, pointed pretty chin, detailed lips, cheekbone shading, stubble texture or individual hair strands. Hair uses 3-5 enormous rounded clumps. Eyes need to feel like ink symbols, not realistic eyes. Simple 3-finger cartoon hand where included. Clothing is 2-3 broad flat shapes, no costume detail.
Landscape sheet SIX LARGE portrait concepts, 3 columns x 2 rows. Top row woman, bottom row man. Each column shows a DISTINCT alternative visual design language. Exactly one large head-and-shoulders drawing per cell. Ivory flat background, generous margins, entire hair/shoulders/hands contained.
COLUMN A label 'A / BOLD CUTOUT': strongest Cult of the Lamb-like graphic simplicity. Thick charcoal organic outline, squat head with huge black vertical oval eyes, tiny bean nose, tiny curved mouth. Woman confident sly eyebrow, man anxious uneven brows. Flat muted rich colors, NO shading except 1 simple shadow shape under hair. Hair rounded chunky asymmetrical silhouette. Adult identity through hair/clothing, not realistic face structure.
COLUMN B label 'B / SQUASHY STORYBOOK': large lumpy rounded head, huge OFF-WHITE oval eyes with tiny black dot pupils (small green dots on woman), tiny round button nose, very wide crooked toothy grin. Woman mischievous delight, man nervous grin. Strong wonky ink, face shapes stretch sideways with smile. One hand up near face. Maximum simple flat 7-color palette.
COLUMN C label 'C / SCRUFFY COMIC': comic grotesque, huge squashed head and mouth, tiny asymmetric dark eyes under expressive arched brows, bold bulbous nose and wonky cheeks; woman in an enormous funny shout and man in open-mouthed disbelief. Mouth occupies half the lower head, few big tooth shapes and tongue, stronger Castle Crashers / hand-drawn Isaac comedic elasticity. Dark bold curved outline. No realistic rendering.
Put the 3 column labels only at TOP. No other text, no logo, no body below shoulders. Make A B C actually differ in silhouette and face construction, not merely eyes. Draw intentionally wonky, thick-inked, almost sticker-like icons; make them strange and charming. Restrained FLAT opaque color blocks, 6-8 colors per portrait, no gradients, texture, lighting rendering or delicate fine lines. This is a fresh graphic design exploration, not an anime character with a thicker border.

assets.name: frog-portraits
assets.prompt:
Make a character concept / expression sheet of the FROG WIZARD in the attached reference, completely redesigned for a chunky inked 2D cartoon game. Visual direction: graphic simplicity and odd charm in the territory of Cult of the Lamb, Castle Crashers and the drawn art of Binding of Isaac. It must NOT be realistic, painterly, anime, manga, glossy 3D or detailed fantasy illustration.
REFERENCE ROLE: identity only. Preserve squat turquoise-blue frog, huge golden amber eyes, floppy bent dark wizard hat with very simplified cream spiral motifs, dark plum scarf/cowl, muted coat and a tiny bronze diamond clasp.
Head is enormous, shoulders tiny, neck almost absent. Giant simple amber discs with solid black pupils, one small off-white glint; no rendered irises or eyelashes. Broad frog mouth is a simple thick curved ink line, with enormous rubbery lower-face/throat potential. Fat rounded webbed fingers. Hat one broad folded cone, brim one clean curved shape, only 2-3 large cream marks. Thick confident wonky charcoal contours, thinner purposeful internal strokes. Flat limited palette 8 colors, ONE flat shadow shape per material maximum. No gradients, stippled skin, fabric texture, tiny decorations or realistic light.
Landscape warm ivory concept sheet with exactly NINE LARGE HEAD-AND-SHOULDERS PORTRAITS in 3 columns x3 rows. Occasional hands near face. Complete hat tips, hands and shoulders stay within cells, generous margins, no rectangular borders. Tiny clear labels below each. Same frog design throughout, visibly elastic acting.
Reading order:
COMPOSED: huge round eyes, broad closed mouth, webbed hands resting together just below chin; benign awkwardness.
CURIOUS: whole head tilts, one eye higher than other, small lips shifted to one side, one finger raised.
SMUG: upper lids lower diagonally, wide offset smirk, chin/throat pushes forward.
DELIGHT: absurdly wide happy frog grin, cheeks expand, eyes squeeze to crescents, fingers spread by cheek.
HOLDING A CROAK: HUGE inflated round turquoise throat ballooning under mouth, pursed sealed lips, bulging eyes; scarf pushed down by throat but remains connected.
OUTRAGED: compressed flat wide head and lowered lids, giant toothless dark yell mouth, hands clenched; hat tip leans with head.
PANIC: head and open mouth stretch tall, tiny pupils in huge amber eyes, splayed webbed fingers, floppy hat springs up.
SHEEPISH: one eye squints, apologetic crooked toothless mouth, chin recedes into scarf, one hand rubs side of head.
SLEEPY: hat slumps over one eye, very heavy lids, loose throat, little yawn and one hand against cheek.
The character should feel like a beautifully designed squishy cartoon puppet with a big soft frog face and hat, funny and distinctive at small size. Show genuinely different skull/throat and hat silhouettes. No human teeth, no realistic wrinkles, no scenery.

assets.name: wooden-portraits
assets.prompt:
Make a NINE POSE portrait character concept sheet of the WOODEN MASK PUPPET in image1, redesigned in the same chunky inked cartoon-game family as the frog style reference image2.
REFERENCE ROLES: image1 is the actual character identity: ivory carved wooden face, dark hollow eyes, short broad nose, wooden lower jaw with a crooked plum smile seam, short log horns tied in burgundy cloth, shaggy straw/wood-strip hair, olive scarf, simple worn shoulder plate, wooden segmented fingers. Image2 is visual style only: flat chunky appealing cartoon shapes and bold curved ink. Do NOT borrow frog eyes, frog skin, wizard hat or frog anatomy.
Target graphic simplicity of Cult of the Lamb, Castle Crashers and drawn Binding of Isaac art. Odd, charming, slightly spooky wooden HUMAN-LIKE puppet, not anime, not realistic, not a shiny 3D toy. Huge lumpy round/squarish head, almost no neck, tiny shoulder area; eyes are simple black holes with a small cream dot/glint. Thick organic near-black outlines. Pale warm ivory mask, ochre wood underside/jaw, burgundy bindings, muted olive scarf, charcoal shoulder armour. 7-9 FLAT colours, one purposeful flat shadow per material at most, absolutely no gradients, realistic grain, texture, tiny chips or detailed costume. Straw hair in only 5 large irregular strips. Horns short rounded log nubs with one red wrap band. One or two hanging brass beads only, not many jewellery details.
Landscape or square warm ivory sheet 3 columns x3 rows of 9 LARGE HEAD-AND-SHOULDERS PORTRAITS with occasional hands near the face, no full body. Complete hair/horn tips/hand silhouettes must fit with generous margins. Neat small labels beneath. Exactly:
COMPOSED: crooked calm mask smile, dark oval sockets, hands loosely together near chest.
CURIOUS: head tilts strongly, one socket taller, one brow plate lifts, articulated wooden finger near chin.
MISCHEVOUS: one cheek plate rises, half-lidded sockets, big off-centre grin with simple segmented wooden jaw.
DELIGHT: jaw drops on side hinges into a broad happy mouth, eye sockets become crescents; hands splay, beads lift from movement.
TRYING TO SMILE: mask corners pull too far, awkward asymmetric wooden grin, one nervous eye socket higher than other, hand touches cheek.
INDIGNANT: cheeks and brow plates angle downward/inward, mouth narrow tense line, chin up, fist held to shoulder.
PANIC: lower jaw swings dramatically down leaving enormous dark open mouth, tiny cream glints inside huge dark sockets, top mask lifts slightly on flexible puppet neck, three-finger wood hands raised.
DEJECTED: head bowed and scarf shoulders slumped, inner eyebrow shapes high, mouth seam droops, straw/horns droop slightly with pose.
PLAYING INNOCENT: eyes glance sideways, lips pinched into tiny round seam, hands behind head or one index held up, one brow plate raised.
Make expression act through CARVED PLATES, jaw hinges, eye socket shapes, head angle and independently layered features. Each wooden plate retains its own solid character while their relationship becomes expressive. Deliberately designed alternate mask shapes can change expression; do not render flesh or stretch detailed wood texture. No strings running through faces. Bold readable silhouettes, very simple colour blocks, strange warm-hearted humour.
